messages:
samantha: Quick sync — sprint update: kernel attention-cache patch landed to branch but canary shows a small QPS/latency regression (~5% p50 increase). Need clear owners for KV warmup + continuous-batching tweak and someone to own the canary verification. ping @raj @jules

raj: On it. I saw the regression spike on the canary dashboard around 14:03 UTC. Initial look: prefetch threadpool saturating when batch sizes spike. Will profile.

jules: I can take KV warmup and prefetch tuning. I have a minimal change to cap prefetch parallelism. Will open a PR shortly.

chris: Heads-up — earlier I rolled back an experimental kernel flag because of variability. Can we add a hard fallback in rollout policy (if p50 increases >3% for 5m) to avoid auto-promote? :warning:

raj: Agree. Adding a fallback rule now. Draft policy snippet: `rollout_policy: monitor: latency_p50 threshold: 0.03 window: 300 action: rollback`

jules: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/487 — changes include:
```yaml
prefetch:
  max_workers: 8
  backoff_ms: 200
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
```
Small perf test locally looks promising (p50 back to baseline).

samantha: Great. Who will own post-merge verification and updating the console dashboards/alerts?

jules: I'll own post-merge verification for the KV side (run synthetic prompt set, validate token throughput).

raj: I'll update the per-route dashboards (p50/p95) and add an alert `perf_regression_kv_kernel` that fires on sustained >2.5% p50 increase over 10m.

infra-ci: CI: build passed for runtime#487, integration tests OK, canary deploy queued. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime-kernel-v1.6.2-canary → region-us-west-2 (10 hosts)

chris: Quick note — please keep manual hold for promote. If deploy-bot reports regression, we do manual rollback and postmortem.

samantha: Action list: (1) jules merge and verify KV warmup + run synth set; (2) raj add dashboard + alert + implement fallback policy; (3) chris be on manual gate for promote. I'll follow up when canary finishes.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: 10/10 hosts healthy, monitoring window 10m started.

deploy-bot: Canary monitoring: no regressions detected in the 10m window — manual promote allowed on owner approval.

samantha: Thanks all. I'll approve promote after jules posts verification results (synth pass) and raj confirms alerts in console. :thumbsup:
